title: CIPL: A Channel-Aware Framework for Recoverable Privacy Leakage in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.21686v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy leakage in LLM agents is commonly evaluated within individual components such as memory, retrieval, or tool-use pipelines, which makes it difficult to distinguish internal exposure from information that an external observer can actually recover. We present CIPL (Channel Inversion for Privacy Leakage), a channel-aware evaluation framework for black-box privacy leakage in LLM agents. CIPL represents a target through sensitive source, selection, assembly, execution, observation, and extraction stages and evaluates the transition from selected sensitive units to attacker-recoverable output under a shared protocol. Experiments across memory-based, retrieval-mediated, and tool-mediated targets, together with a BrowserUse live-agent case study, show that storage labels alone do not determine recoverability. Memory targets form a near-saturated reference case, retrieval-mediated leakage is frequently partial, and tool-mediated and live

translated_title: CIPL：一种面向大语言模型智能体可恢复隐私泄露的信道感知框架
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体中的隐私泄露通常是在记忆、检索或工具使用流水线等单个组件内部进行评估的，这使得难以区分内部暴露与外部观察者实际能够恢复的信息。我们提出了CIPL（Channel Inversion for Privacy Leakage，面向隐私泄露的信道反转），一个用于评估LLM智能体黑盒隐私泄露的信道感知框架。CIPL通过敏感源、选择、组装、执行、观察和提取等阶段来刻画攻击目标，并在统一协议下评估从被选中的敏感单元到攻击者可恢复输出的转变过程。在基于记忆的、检索中介的和工具中介的目标上开展的实验，以及BrowserUse真实智能体的案例研究表明，仅凭存储标签并不能决定可恢复性。记忆目标构成了一个近乎饱和的参考案例，检索中介的泄露通常是部分的，而工具中介的和真实（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CIPL提出了一种信道感知的黑盒评估框架，将LLM智能体的隐私泄露建模为从被选中的敏感单元到攻击者可恢复输出的信道转变过程，并通过实验证明仅凭存储标签无法决定隐私信息的实际可恢复性。
en_tdlr: CIPL is a channel-aware black-box evaluation framework that models privacy leakage in LLM agents as the transition from selected sensitive units to attacker-recoverable output, showing through experiments that storage labels alone do not determine recoverability.
